decisions.reason: As a data-driven add-on tightly leveraging the firm's existing market-data assets and support capabilities, it still offers low-cost cross-selling and learning value worth keeping open.
The gas tariff comparison product remains close to the core offer, but after two sales cycles demand is becoming clearer, so exit risk rises somewhat even though we would still keep it.
This regional electricity tariff calculator sits very near the firm's core calculation and billing activities, making it a strategically reinforcing and relatively cheap option to retain.
After two years with only limited website prominence and overlap with other tariff-calculation offers, the option value looks largely resolved and resources are better redirected elsewhere.
The area definition tool reuses existing data and process know-how and supports the firm's platform and integration logic, so it remains a worthwhile low-cost complementary product to keep.
